whatIs: HeadlessX is a self-hosted scraping platform. It exposes an API on top of a custom-built Firefox (Camoufox) designed to resist bot detection, and returns JavaScript-rendered HTML, clean Markdown or full-page screenshots. It includes API keys, queued jobs, a CLI and MCP support.
It's a good fit when you'd rather run your own scraping infrastructure than pay for an external service. It ships with ready-made scrapers for websites, Google searches and YouTube.
uses: Convert JavaScript-heavy pages into Markdown to feed an AI or search pipeline.
Crawl a site and map its links from a job queue with an API key.
Connect it to n8n or Zapier to automate recurring data extraction.
caveats: You have to run it yourself: development mode requires Docker with Compose v2, Node.js 22+ and pnpm; production requires a VPS with Docker, two domains and ports 80 and 443 open.
It recommends 4 or more cores and 8-16 GB of RAM; the minimum is 2 cores and 4 GB.
The license is AGPL-3.0: if you offer a modified version as a network service, you must publish its source code. Also check the terms of the sites you plan to crawl.
pricingNote: Open source under the AGPL-3.0 license; you only pay for the infrastructure where you run it.
idealFor: Teams that want their own scraping platform with full control.
